title: Complete the eight-quarter covenant forecast
prompt:
Edit this file in place:
`Shared/Finance/Treasury/Bank - covenants/FY27 covenant forecast - WORKING.xlsx`

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Work through the shared finance folders as an Alder Ridge analyst would: determine which controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts are current, use prior versions only for permitted comparison, and resolve conflicts from dates, approvals, document status, and the management correspondence. Reconcile any Alder Ridge posted baseline through the contractor-accounting MCP; external target, peer, bank, or market evidence remains controlled by the applicable finance source and must not be forced into Alder Ridge's ledger.

This is an independently reset assignment. Build the deliverable from the shared company sources and do not copy an output produced by another task.

Preserve `Forecast Inputs` and `Debt Schedule`. Complete `Covenant Forecast`, `Downside`, and `Checks` for eight quarters. Model rolling-twelve-month EBITDA, funded debt, cash interest, scheduled principal, cash taxes, unfunded capex, tangible net worth, leverage, FCCR, and covenant headroom using the executed definitions. Include acquisition debt only in the quarter it closes and acquisition EBITDA only from the permitted pro-forma date. Flag the first breach and required debt paydown with rolling-period, debt, threshold, and source controls.

Document the controlling sources inside the deliverable. Recalculate or render as appropriate and save to the exact target path. The file is graded.
